How It Works

Get your shared expenses organized in 4 straightforward steps.

01

Create a Group

Set up a group for your trip, housemates, or event in seconds.

02

Add an Expense

Log bills as they happen, specifying who paid and who shares the cost.

03

Split the Expense

SplitMate automatically divides the bill and updates individual shares.

04

Track & Settle Balances

Review net balances and mark items as settled when payments are made.
